verdict.rationale: TaxJar documents a per-line-item `product_tax_code` parameter and an API for retrieving tax categories, so developers can map catalog items to its taxability codes. Its own client library says these rules cover only "a subset of product categories", and the product is positioned as US-only. missing for 10: evidence that SaaS, digital goods, services and physical products are each covered as categories, coverage beyond a subset of categories, documented jurisdiction-by-jurisdiction taxability across every selling jurisdiction, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can map my catalog to the vendor's tax categories — SaaS, digital goods, services, physical products — so each line item is taxed by what it is, in every jurisdiction it sells

citations.quote: the TaxJar API allows you to submit a `product_tax_code` parameter with each `line_item` in an order.
You can use our API to get information on sales tax rates, categories or upload transactions.
The TaxJar API provides product-level tax rules for a subset of product categories.
Simply pass in a value of **20010** in the `product_tax_code` parameter of a `line_item`, and we’ll do the work for you.
